_comment: Copy to site-publish.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. Never commit the copy.
_hostFingerprint: SFTP only. The base64 part of: ssh-keyscan -t rsa <host> | ssh-keygen -lf -  Compare it with the fingerprint your provider publishes before the first upload.
_remotePath: Directory the domain serves from, as seen by the SFTP account. Strato: often /<sitename> or /httpdocs.
